offer.title: Something new
tool.reach_site: Asked to reach a new site
cap.files.name: Files
cap.files.offer: You can drop files on me: PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, text or pictures. You can also capture your screen.
cap.made.name: Documents and spreadsheets
cap.computer.name: Computer
cap.computer.offer: Want exact numbers, or work done on your files? Turn on a computer in a sandbox on this device: it runs commands, JavaScript and Python.
cap.reflexes.name: Intuition
cap.reflexes.offer: Let {name} get a feel for what you need? A small helper ({size}, once) picks the right brain and suggests next steps, without sending anything anywhere.
cap.reflexes.failed: Intuition couldn’t be downloaded. Try again later.
cap.meaning.name: Search by meaning
cap.meaning.offer: Find what your files say, even in other words or another language? A small helper ({size}, once) reads them on this device. Nothing leaves it.
cap.meaning.failed: Search by meaning couldn’t be downloaded. Try again later.
cap.backup.name: Backup
cap.backup.offer: Your tasks live only in this browser. Keep a copy of everything?
cap.sync.name: Sync
cap.sync.offer: Keep your tasks, files and memory the same on your other computers? You choose a folder that your cloud drive syncs.
cap.brain-local.name: A brain on this device
cap.memory.name: Memory
cap.memory.offer: Want me to remember things like this from now on? You can see and change everything I keep.
cap.projects.name: Projects
cap.projects.offer: Shall I make this a project? Its notes and files would stay separate.
cap.folders.name: Folders
cap.folders.offer: Work on the files of a folder on this computer, where they are?
cap.skills.name: Skills
cap.skills.offer: This is the third time you’ve asked for something like this. Save it as a skill, so it’s done the same way every time?
cap.routines.name: Routines
cap.routines.offer: You’ve asked for this on three different days. Make it a routine, done on its own on a schedule?
suggest.skill.prompt: Save what you just did as a skill, so it’s done the same way next time.
suggest.routine.prompt: Make this a routine, done on a schedule that fits how often I ask for it.
cap.flows.name: Flows
cap.flows.offer: That took several steps. Keep steps like these as a flow, to see them, change them and run them again?
suggest.flow: Save these steps as a flow
suggest.flow.prompt: Save what you just did as a flow, so I can see its steps, change them and run it again.
suggest.ready: See a skill that does this
tool.suggest_skill: Looked for a skill that fits
cap.search.name: Web search
cap.search.offer: This needs a look on the web. Search when a question needs it? Answers will show their sources.
cap.browser.name: Browser
cap.browser.offer: Open web pages beside the conversation, to look at them while you talk?
cap.connections.name: Connections
cap.connections.offer: This needs one of your services. Connect it? You’ll be asked before anything is done there.
cap.plugins.name: Plugins
cap.plugins.offer: Someone may have made a plugin for this. Add one? You’ll see what it asks before it’s added.
cap.live.name: Live conversation
cap.live.offer: You dictate often. Talk hands-free instead? Answers are read aloud, and you can interrupt. About {size}, once.

preview.locked: This cell can only be changed in a spreadsheet app

cap.pictures.offer: Make pictures and short films from a description, or change a picture you share?
cap.helpers.name: Helpers
cap.helpers.offer: This is a big task with separate parts. Hand them to helpers, who work on them at the same time?
cap.check.name: Double-check
cap.check.offer: Double-check each answer against its sources? It takes one more short request per answer.
cap.since.name: Since last time
cap.since.offer: Welcome back. Want a short brief of what’s new in your services each time you return? It only reads.
cap.names.name: Assistant names
cap.names.offer: Want to give this project’s assistant a name?
cap.find.name: Search
cap.find.offer: There’s a lot to look back on now. Search all your tasks and files in one place?
